resources.string: Going back or leaving the page disconnects the view and keeps commands running. Close terminal stops the selected terminal and all its child processes, including commands started with &; other terminals and conversation tasks are unaffected. The default lease is two hours, with reclamation after 30 minutes detached. Output does not extend these limits. App updates, runtime termination by Android, or device restarts may also stop the processes.

The initial directory is the directory mapped to /workspace when creating a terminal, not its current working directory. cd changes only this terminal; use pwd to see its location. Reconnecting keeps that location.
Conversation Bash commands and Linux Jobs run separately from this interactive terminal. A Job uses its own input copy for /workspace, so the same path need not refer to the manual terminal’s files.

Tap the terminal to show the keyboard; hide it from the toolbar for more reading space. Scrolling and text selection do not request the keyboard. Expand More keys for editing shortcuts and symbols. Read-only connections cannot send input.
Uses the compact Inconsolata monospace font with pinch-to-zoom. The system supplies missing glyphs, including Chinese; terminal cells remain aligned. Font attribution is under Component licenses.
